prompt: Create desktop UI mockup for ABI Catalog, same minimal white/light-gray and restrained sky-blue app grammar as prior reference o11 screenshots, crisp near-black text, generous whitespace, flat softly rounded gray rows. Landscape 3:2. Header ABI; Overview, Catalog selected, Connect, Billing, Settings; blue Connect your agent button. Main title 'Find what your agent needs'. Three equally prominent segmented choices Tools & APIs, Software, Physical goods; Tools & APIs selected. Quiet search field 'Search a provider, tool, product or task'. Secondary Providers / Tools toggle and small categories All, Search, Data, Media, Productivity. Explicit 'Demo catalog — illustrative listings' label. Four full-width spacious rows with simple tasteful neutral icons: 'Search service / API tool · Per request · Inspect pricing'; 'Workspace templates / Digital software · Instant delivery'; 'Trailhead daypack / Physical goods · Stock and shipping'; 'Weekend trail guide / Digital product · Download'. Rows show details arrow, type, availability details, no invented integration logos, no fake provider counts or endorsements. Right small optional inspector for selected Search service: 'Before you run', Account 'Choose funding or a connected account', effect Read-only, Price 'Quote required', action 'Review tool details', no pretend production payment. Subtle bottom five-icon dock same as app header. No navy sidebar, no charts, no layered cards, no leather, no decorative imagery. Operational minimalism prioritizing all three kinds of commerce equally. Exact ABI labels, not o11 branding.
scope: ABI redesign studies inspired by public o11 design; not live functionality
notes: Generated text and capabilities are proposals. Keep key administration in Connect; do not literalize sidebar from billing study as permanently exposing secrets. No free-credit promise or existing card processor is implied.
